# Open Cycle Gas Turbine (GasTurbine_OCGT)

> **Class**: `GasTurbine_OCGT` | **Module**: `energysim.models.thermal` | [Validation benchmarks](../validation.md) | [Units](../units.md)

## Overview

Open-Cycle Gas Turbine (OCGT) peaker plant.

A unit-commitment style model: an operating state machine
(OFF -> STARTING -> RUNNING -> OFF) with cold/warm/hot start durations,
enforced minimum up- and down-time, ramp limits, an ambient-temperature
capacity derate curve and a part-load heat-rate curve. Once STARTING the
start always completes (command dips do not abort it) and the unit
synchronises at minimum stable generation (MSG), then ramps toward the
setpoint. While below ``min_uptime_sec`` a stop command holds the unit at
MSG. A start command is ignored until ``min_downtime_sec`` has elapsed.

Validity: T_amb -20..45 C, loads between MSG and rated; no emissions
transients, no turbine inertia dynamics, no humidity or altitude effects.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `'OCGT'` | - | - |
| `p_rated_mw` | `float` | `100.0` | MW | Nominal ISO rated electrical capacity in MW (at 15 C, sea level). |
| `heat_rate_full_load_kj_kwh` | `float` | `9800.0` | kJ/kWh | Full load heat rate in kJ/kWh (LHV). |
| `ramp_rate_mw_min` | `float` | `30.0` | MW/min | Maximum ramp rate in MW/min. |
| `min_stable_gen_pct` | `float` | `30.0` | % | Minimum Stable Generation (MSG) limit in % of rated power. |
| `cold_start_duration_sec` | `float` | `1200.0` | s | Time to synchronize and reach MSG from cold state. |
| `warm_start_duration_sec` | `float` | `600.0` | s | Time to synchronize from warm state. |
| `hot_start_duration_sec` | `float` | `300.0` | s | Time to synchronize from hot state. |
| `ambient_derate_curve` | `Optional[Curve1D]` | `None` | - | - |
| `heat_rate_curve` | `Optional[Curve1D]` | `None` | - | - |
| `step_size` | `float` | `1.0` | s | - |
| `min_uptime_sec` | `float` | `1800.0` | s | Minimum running time (after synchronisation) before a stop is allowed. |
| `min_downtime_sec` | `float` | `1800.0` | s | Minimum offline time before a restart is allowed. |

## Usage example

```python
from energysim import world
from energysim.models import GasTurbine_OCGT

sim = world(start_time=0, stop_time=3600, t_macro=900)
sim.add_model('gasturbine_ocgt', model=GasTurbine_OCGT(), outputs=['P_actual', 'fuel_consumption_MMBtu_hr', 'Q_exhaust_MW'], step_size=60)
res = sim.simulate()
print(res['gasturbine_ocgt'].tail(2))
```
